title: Implant purpose and bloodline hybrid program

tellings.quote: Um that it was a medical monitoring device is my understanding uh to or monitor things like blood sugar and body temperature and things like that.

plain: Steve Colbern, a scientist who studies objects people say were planted in their bodies by aliens, says his understanding is that one such implant was a medical monitoring device. He tells Michels it seemed built to track things like blood sugar and body temperature, which, if true, would mean someone was keeping watch on the health of the person who carried it.
